name: Pony XL
description: Pony Diffusion V6 XL and its finetunes: SDXL models trained heavily on booru-tagged art. Prompts are comma-separated tags, led by the score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up quality ladder and a source_ tag (source_anime, source_cartoon, source_furry). Huge LoRA ecosystem, very strong at characters, anatomy and NSFW. Artist names do little; use style LoRAs instead.
best_for: Anime, cartoon and furry characters; NSFW; anything where a Pony LoRA already exists for the character, outfit or concept you want.
agent_hint: SDXL / Pony: booru tags with the score_ ladder and a source_ tag; pick the checkpoint from the Pony_XL folder.

name: Illustrious
description: Illustrious-XL (OnomaAI) and its community finetunes such as WAI: SDXL trained on Danbooru. Native language is Danbooru tags (spaces, not underscores) with masterpiece / best quality tiers; artist tags work, unlike Pony. The biggest local LoRA library (500+). Sharp, clean anime illustration with strong character knowledge.
best_for: Anime and illustration, known characters by name, artist-style mimicry, and the widest choice of style, clothing and concept LoRAs.
agent_hint: SDXL / Illustrious: Danbooru tags, quality tags first; pick the checkpoint from the Illustrious folder.

name: Anima
description: Anima (CircleStone Labs × Comfy Org): a new 2B anime/illustration model built on NVIDIA Cosmos-Predict2, with a Qwen3 0.6B text encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE. Trained on Danbooru tags plus natural language, so the best prompts are lowercase booru tags (with spaces) optionally followed by prose. Artists need an @ prefix (@kantoku), weights need higher values than SDXL (1.5–2), and every prompt should carry a safety tag (safe / sensitive / nsfw / explicit).
best_for: Modern anime illustration with better prompt following than SDXL: mixing tags with sentences, multi-character scenes, and artist styles via @artist.
agent_hint: Anima: needs its own text encoder (text-encoders/Anima) and the Qwen-Image VAE (vae/Anima). Tags lowercase with spaces; include a safety tag.

name: Krea 2
description: Krea 2: a diffusion transformer whose text encoder is the Qwen3-VL vision-language model, so it reads reference images natively. A reference fed to the encoder transfers pose, camera angle, framing and mood while the prompt still decides the subject; the structural edit patch reproduces identity for editing. Natural-language prompts. Local finetunes cover realism, anime and more, and it trains well for LoRAs on the 4090.
best_for: Photoreal and semi-real images, pose and camera-angle transfer from a reference photo, outfit transfer, and editing an existing image while keeping the person.
agent_hint: Krea 2 reference path: TextEncodeKrea2 image1 (vision tokens) for pose/angle; Krea2EditModelPatch for identity/edit; Rebalance pack for up to 4 weighted refs.

name: Qwen Image 2.1
description: Qwen-Image 2.1: one model that does both text-to-image and image editing, with a Qwen3-VL 8B encoder that also encodes the reference images (up to 10 wired in the templates). Excellent prompt following and text rendering (English and Chinese), multi-reference composition ("the woman from image 1 wearing the jacket from image 2"), and the local Heretic prompt enhancers expand short prompts.
best_for: Precise edits, combining several reference images, readable text and signage, and complex scenes that must follow a long description exactly.
agent_hint: Qwen-Image 2.1: describe each reference's role by number; prompt enhancers qwen-image-2.1-pe-t2i-heretic / -i2i-heretic are available.

name: Z-Image Turbo
description: Z-Image Turbo (Alibaba Tongyi): a 6B single-stream DiT distilled to about 8 steps, with a Qwen3 4B text encoder. Very fast, strong photorealism and good bilingual text rendering, from plain natural-language prompts. No negative prompt at CFG 1.
best_for: Fast photoreal drafts and finals, portraits and everyday scenes, quick iteration when you want many variations.
agent_hint: Z-Image Turbo: ~8 steps, CFG 1, natural language; LoRAs trained on Z-Image Base mostly work.
